name: PX-FOOTRIX
summary: PX-FOOTRIX is a Hall-array tactile sensor for the soles of bipedal robots. It measures distributed three-dimensional contact force and six-dimensional force/torque to support gait control and terrain response. Left-foot and right-foot options are separately selectable under the same model name. SPI is standard; UART, USB and RS485 require an optional adapter, while I2C and CAN FD require customization. The cover illustrates both handedness alternatives, not a bundled pair.

The cover illustrates both handedness alternatives, not a bundled pair.
